title: Sinusoidal positional encodings extrapolation untested
description: The authors hypothesized that sinusoidal positional encodings may allow the model to extrapolate to sequence lengths longer than those encountered during training, but this was not tested.
canonical_description: sinusoidal positional encodings may extrapolate to unseen sequence lengths

evidence.anchor: may allow the model to extrapolate to sequence lengths longer than the ones encountered during training
evidence.quote: We chose the sinusoidal version because it may allow the model to extrapolate to sequence lengths longer than the ones encountered during training.
